$comment: Map and imagery data Stratlas distributes or ships (M10 decision 4), the data inventory behind docs/release/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md. Imagery and terrain sources are checked by data-licences.mjs like the pack metadata built from them; street maps (vector PMTiles, MapPackInfo) predate M10 and are listed for the inventory only. Packs a customer imports under their own licence are never listed here and never redistributed by us.
